HOW THIS SCAN WORKS

Evidence before an option contract.

Shortlist: positive GAAP earnings, revenue growth and improving net income versus the same quarter a year earlier in three or four recent reports. Rank is a research judgment, not a return forecast.

Drawdown: measured from the stated 52-week or all-time high, using adjusted prices where relevant. The broader list includes earnings-quality, consistency and macro exceptions.

LEAPS check: investigate late 2028 or 2029 expirations, 0.65–0.80 delta, open interest and bid–ask spreads. Availability is not liquidity. Verify current earnings, quotes and break-even before trading; the entire premium can be lost.
